limitation: Logged support and causal information set are separate from learner capability
inspection: Primary README/license/package or repository metadata; selected API source where saved. No runtime package benchmark.
pin_limit: Content hashes pin actual saved artifacts. Retrieved HEAD, if present, is a separate observation; mutable-branch files are not asserted to belong to that commit.

scientific_qualification.input: Episode-indexed state/action/reward/terminal data and a selected offline-RL model.
scientific_qualification.output: Learned policy and value approximations under the learning objective.
scientific_qualification.assumptions: Sufficient state/history, invariant reward/transition semantics, adequate behavior support and valid independent evaluation.
scientific_qualification.adapter_rule: Separate policy fitting from causal identification and OPE; retain terminal/truncation distinction. Pin v2 API and training configuration. Distributed training does not establish policy-value coverage.
scientific_qualification.acceptance_test: Train on a small known MDP, evaluate on independent trajectories, then remove an action from logging support; report unsupported policy choices instead of certifying them from Q-values.

evidence.finding: Offline/online APIs, v2 breaking changes, declared distributed training and supported algorithm table.
